title: Evaluate Division
summary: Answer division queries between named variables from a set of known ratios.

tests.explain: a / c = (a / b) * (b / c) = 6. b / a = 1/2. e is unknown, so a / e is -1. a / a is 1 because a is known. x is unknown, so even x / x is -1.
a, b, c form one group and bc, cd another; a query across groups would be -1. Here a / c = 3.75, c / b = 0.4, and the second group gives 5 and 0.2.
Only one equation: a / b = 0.5, so b / a = 2.

hints: Each equation says a / b = k. That is also b / a = 1 / k. Draw variables as nodes and equations as weighted edges in both directions.
A query c / d is answered by multiplying the edge weights along any path from c to d. Ratios along different paths in a consistent system agree, so the first path you find is enough.

Build an adjacency map from each variable to [neighbour, weight] pairs, with both directions. For each query, return -1 if either variable is unknown, 1 if they are the same known variable, otherwise run a DFS or BFS from c carrying the product so far, and return it when you reach d (or -1 if you never do).

complexity.time: O(Q * (V + E)): one traversal per query
